en.title: Queue image parts in Play views
en.body: Play views with many cold image parts now queue their loads, with up to four declarative loads running at once. Closing or rebuilding a view discards its queued requests.

zh.title: Play 视图的图片部件按队列加载
zh.body: Play 视图首次打开且包含多张图片时，会把图片排入队列，同时最多执行四个声明式加载。关闭或重建视图会丢弃对应的排队请求。
